est|project: The project (site code) this row belongs to. Projects come from Settings > Companies & sites. Click the row to open that project.
est|client: The client (employer) of the project. Typed or picked on the project details; it prints on certificates and exports.
est|consultant: The consultant who certifies the client's payment certificates and answers RFIs. Typed or picked on the project details.
est|status: Where this item stands in its own workflow. Moved on with the buttons on the row (or picked in its form); the chips above the table filter by it.
est|subcontractor: The subcontractor or supplier this subcontract, LPO or certificate is with. Picked from the suppliers in Store & Purchasing, or typed when new.
est|pc: The payment certificate number for this subcontract (PC 01, 02 ...), given in order as invoices are logged. Advance, Final or Retention release PCs show their type under it.
est|payable: What this certificate pays, VAT included. Worked out: This PC (net to date now less net to date at the last PC) plus VAT at the subcontract's VAT %.
est|this pc: What this certificate itself certifies, before VAT. Worked out: net to date on this PC less net to date on the PC before, so the PCs always add up to the total. Negative means money is taken back.
est|net to date: Everything certified up to this PC, before VAT. Worked out: work done + variations + material on site + advance paid - advance recovered - retention + retention released - other deductions, all to date.
est|vat: VAT on This PC. Worked out: This PC x the VAT % (normally 5%) set on the subcontract or project.
est|pc due: The date the PC should be issued by. Worked out: date the invoice was received in office + the PC days allowed (Days button on the Invoice tracker). Red with (+days) when late.
est|invoice: The subcontractor's invoice number for this PC, with its date. Typed when the invoice is logged (+ Invoice received) or on the certificate.
est|amount: The money figure for this line, in AED. Typed, or worked out from qty x rate where the line has both.
est|description: What the line is: the item, work or reason as it should read on the printouts. Typed or brought in from the Excel.
est|qty: The quantity for this line, in its unit. Typed or brought in from the Excel; with the rate it gives the amount (qty x rate).
est|unit: The unit the quantity is measured in (m2, m3, nos, LS ...). Typed or brought in from the Excel.
est|rate: Price per unit in AED. Typed or brought in from the Excel; qty x rate gives the amount when no amount is typed.
The reference of this item - the letter, instruction or document number it is known by. Typed; used for search and printed on exports.
est|date: The date of this entry. Typed or picked; today's date is filled in for a new one.
est|submitted: The date it was sent. Filled in with today's date by the Submitted button, or typed in the form.
est|received: The date it came in. Typed or picked; today's date is filled in for a new one.
est|paid: Money paid to the subcontractor so far, VAT included. Worked out: the total of the Amount paid figures entered when PCs were marked paid.
est|to pay: Certified but not yet paid, VAT included. Worked out: net to date on the last PC + VAT on all PCs - amount paid so far. Red when something is waiting.
est|certified: Value certified to date, before VAT. Worked out from the certificates (net to date of the latest one).
est|work: The work (scope) of this subcontract, e.g. Blockworks, Electrical Works. Picked or typed on the subcontract.
est|done: How far the subcontract work has gone. Worked out: (work + variations done to date on the last PC) / revised value x 100. Over 100% means more is certified than the revised value.
est|item: The item this row tracks. Typed when the row is added; most lists start with the standard items for a villa project.
est|bill: The bill (trade section) the lines belong to, e.g. B1 or 02. Substructure, as in the BOQ or agreement. Brought in from the Excel or typed.
est|lines: How many lines were read from the Excel for this row. Shown before anything is saved so you can check the file was read right.
est|contract: Total of the contract lines read from this sheet. Checked against the sheet's own total row; the tag beside it shows if they match.
est|sheet: The sheet (tab) of the uploaded Excel workbook the lines were read from.
est|measured by: How the line is certified each month: % done, Measured W x H + % done, or Quantity x rate. Guessed from the Excel; can be changed later in the item schedule.
The running number of this entry in the log (RFI-001, SUB-001, T-001). Given automatically in order.
est|due: The date a reply is due. Left empty, it is set from the sent date + the days allowed (button above the table). Red with ! when passed and no reply yet.
est|discipline: Which side of the design it concerns (Civil, Structural, MEP, Architectural ...). Picked from the list; used to sort and filter.
est|to: Who the item was sent to (Consultant, Client, Developer, authority ...). Picked from the list.
est|sent: The date it was sent. Typed or picked; today is filled in for a new one. The reply due date counts from it.
est|reply: The date the reply came back. Filled in by the Answer / Reply received button, or typed. Empty means still waiting.
est|type: The kind of entry, picked in its form. A certificate: Interim, Advance, Final or Retention release. A subcontract: Subcontract, LPO or Manpower. A variation: Addition, Omission or Coordination.
est|value: The original amount, before VAT and before variations. Typed on the form.
est|revised: The amount after changes. Worked out from the original plus approved changes.
est|retention: Retention held to date, shown as a deduction. Worked out from the retention % unless typed on the certificate.
est|adv. recovery: Advance recovered to date, shown as a deduction. Worked out from the advance % unless typed on the certificate.
est|name: The project's name, e.g. the villa and plot. Filled in from the site when the project is made; changed with Edit details.
est|location: Where the project is - the community and plot number. Typed on Edit details; printed on the certificates.
est|qs: The quantity surveyor in charge of this project. Picked from the app's users on the project details.
est|start: The project's start date. Typed on Edit details; for reference and reports.
est|completion: The planned completion date of the project. Typed on Edit details; for reference and reports.
est|notes: Free notes for the team. Typed; not used in any figure.
est|advance from client: The advance payment % the client pays Infinia at the start. It is recovered back from each client payment certificate. Set on the project details.
est|retention held by client: The % the client keeps back from each certificate until handover and defects liability end. Set on the project details; retention to date is worked out from it.
est|retention by client: The % the client keeps back from each certificate until handover and defects liability end. Set on the project details; retention to date is worked out from it.
est|work done to date: Value of work done up to this PC (not just this month), before VAT; an advance paid on the PC shows under it. Typed on the quick form or added up from the lines on the sheet.
est|inv. amount: The amount on the subcontractor's invoice, as they claimed it. Typed when the invoice is logged; it is compared with what is certified, not used in the figures.
Other deductions to date: back-charges, manpower or material supplied by Infinia, damages. Typed on the quick form or added up from the deduction lines on the sheet (only lines ticked Taken).
est|ret. release: Retention released back to the subcontractor to date. Typed on the certificate (Half / All buttons); it is added back in the net to date.
est.dash|contract: The project's revised contract value. Worked out: contract value (from the project, else Accounts > Project payments, else the BOQ value) + approved variations.
est.dash|certified: What the consultant has certified to Infinia so far, before VAT. Worked out: net to date of the latest client certificate that is Certified, Invoiced or Paid.
est.dash|progress: How much of the work the client has certified. Worked out: work certified on the latest certified client PC / revised contract value x 100.
est.dash|received: Money received from the client for this project. Read from Accounts > Project payments; nothing is typed here.
est.dash|subcontracts: Total committed to subcontractors. Worked out: sum of the revised values (value + variations - cancellations) of every subcontract that is not Cancelled.
est.dash|sub to pay: Certified to subcontractors but not yet paid, VAT included. Worked out: for each subcontract, net to date + VAT on all PCs - amount paid, added up.
est.dash|margin: What is left of the contract after subcontracts. Worked out: revised contract value - total of the subcontracts' revised values. Red when negative.
est.dash|status: Projects table: the project's status (Running, Tender, On hold, Handed over, Closed), set on its details. Invoices table: the step the subcontractor invoice is at, from Received to With Accounts.
est.dash|payable: What this subcontractor PC pays, VAT included: This PC + VAT. Worked out from the certificate; shown once work done is entered.
est.home.dash|ipa: The client payment certificate (interim payment application) number. Made on Overview > Payment certificates; the last four are shown.
est.home.dash|period to: The date this client certificate covers work up to. Typed on the certificate (Period up to).
est.home.dash|certified: IPA table: net to date on that client certificate (certified figure once certified, claimed until then). Subcontractors table: net to date on the subcontract's latest PC, before VAT.
est.home.dash|revised value: The subcontract value after changes. Worked out: subcontract / LPO amount + its variations - any LPO cancellation.
est.home.dash|status: IPA table: Draft, Submitted, Certified, Invoiced or Paid. Subcontractors: Active, Completed, Closed or Cancelled. Invoices: the step the invoice is at. Project details: the project's status.
est.home.dash|invoice: The subcontractor's invoice number for this PC. Typed when the invoice is logged.
est.home.dash|payable: What this PC pays, VAT included: This PC + VAT. Shown once work done (or an advance) is entered on the certificate.
est.subs.reg|agreement / lpo: The subcontract agreement number and / or LPO number. Typed on the subcontract form; printed on its certificates.
est.subs.reg|value: The subcontract / LPO amount as signed, before VAT and before variations. Typed on the subcontract form.
est.subs.reg|vos: Total of the variations to this subcontract (omissions are minus). Added on the subcontract with + Variation.
est.subs.reg|revised: The subcontract value after changes. Worked out: value + VOs - LPO cancellation. Done %, balance work and margin are measured against it.
est.subs.reg|certified: Certified to this subcontractor to date, before VAT. Worked out: net to date on the latest PC (work + variations + material on site + advance - recovery - retention + release - deductions).
est.subs.reg|retention held: Retention Infinia still holds from this subcontractor. Worked out: retention to date on the latest PC - retention released to date.
est.subs.reg|pcs: How many payment certificates this subcontract has, of every type and status.
est.subs.reg|status: The subcontract's status: Active, Completed, Closed or Cancelled. Set on the subcontract form; cancelled subcontracts are left out of the committed total.
est.sub|paid: The amount actually paid on this PC, VAT included. Entered when the PC is marked paid (filled in with the payable).
est.sub|retention: Retention held to date on this PC, shown as a deduction. Worked out: retention % x (work + variations to date), unless typed on the certificate.
est.sub|adv. recovery: Advance recovered to date on this PC. Worked out: advance % x contract work done to date, never more than the advance paid (no %: advance / revised value x work), unless typed.
est.sub|status: PCs: the step the certificate is at (Received, At site, Back from site, Certified, PC issued, With Accounts, Paid). Project details: the project's status.
est.sub|amount: The variation amount, before VAT. Negative for an omission. It is added to the subcontract's revised value.
The variation number (V01, V02 ...), given in order as each variation is added.
est.sub|date: The date of the variation. Typed or picked on the variation; the list is in date order.
est.sub|description: What the variation covers. Typed on the variation.
est.sub|vat: The VAT % that applies to this project's certificates and invoices. Set on the project details.
est.subs.inv|amount: The amount on the subcontractor's invoice, as claimed. Typed when the invoice is logged; the certified figure may differ.
est.subs.inv|received: The date the invoice was received in the office. Typed when it is logged; the PC due date counts from it.
est.subs.inv|site: When the invoice went to site for checking (out) and came back (back), or the date it is due back: out date + the site days allowed. Shows days late in red.
est.subs.inv|progress: The invoice's journey as dots: Received, At site, Back from site, Certified, PC issued, With Accounts, Paid. Filled dots are done; the outlined one is the current step.
est.subs.inv|status: The step the invoice / PC is at now. Moved on with the Next step button (or back with the arrow); each step stamps today's date.
est.subs.inv|next step: The button for the next step (Sent to site, Certify, PC issued, Send to Accounts, Mark paid). Certify opens the certificate; Mark paid asks the amount and reference.
est.subs.pcs|issued: The date the PC was issued. Stamped when the PC issued button is pressed.
est.subs.pcs|to accounts: The date the PC was sent to Accounts for payment. Stamped by Send to Accounts.
est.subs.pcs|paid: The date the PC was paid, with the cheque or transfer reference under it. Entered by Accounts when marking it paid.
est.subs.pcs|paid amount: The amount actually paid, VAT included. Entered when marking it paid (filled in with the payable).
est.subs.pcs|status: Certified, PC issued, With Accounts or Paid. Moved on with the button on the row; Accounts marks it paid.
est.subs.final|item: The trade or package to be finalized on the project (Steel, Blockworks, Lift ...), grouped by Civil, MEP and External. Standard list; add others with + Item.
est.subs.final|subcontractor: Who does this item. Picked from the project's subcontracts, or + New subcontract to make one already linked to the line.
est.subs.final|scope: Whose scope the item is: C main contractor (Infinia), E employer, PS provisional sum, N/A not needed. Click the box to move to the next value.
est.subs.final|rate finalized: Whether the subcontract rate for this item is agreed: done, X not yet, or N/A. Click the box to change it.
est.subs.final|shop drawing: Whether the shop drawings for this item are approved: done, X not yet, or N/A. Click the box to change it.
est.subs.final|material approval: Whether the material submittal for this item is approved: done, X not yet, or N/A. Click the box to change it.
est.subs.final|authority approval: Whether any authority approval this item needs (DM, DEWA, Civil Defence ...) is in hand: done, X not yet, or N/A. Click the box to change it.
est.subs.final|final status: Whether the item is fully finalized: done, X not yet, or N/A. Done items count in the n / total shown on the tab.
est.subs.final|section: The group the item sits under: CIVIL, MEP, EXTERNAL or OTHER.
est.client.boq|item: The item number of the line as in the internal BOQ. Brought in from the Excel or typed.
est.client.boq|amount: The line amount to the client. Worked out: qty x rate, or the figure the internal BOQ gives (lump sums). Greyed out when the line is not in scope and not counted.
est.client.boq|budget: Budget cost of the line. Worked out: qty x your cost rate (nothing for lines not in scope). BOQ value less budget gives the budget margin.
est.client.boq|done %: How far this line is done, for your own tracking. Click the figure to type it; it stays when a newer BOQ revision is uploaded.
est.client.boq|qty: The line's quantity as in the internal BOQ. Click the figure to change it; the amount is worked out again (qty x rate).
est.client.boq|rate: The line's rate to the client. Click the figure to change it; the amount is worked out again (qty x rate).
est.client.boq|cost rate: Your budget cost per unit. Click the figure to type it; budget = qty x cost rate.
est.client.boq|counted: Value of the lines in this bill that are in the awarded scope and counted in the BOQ value.
est.client.boq|left out: Bills or sections the internal BOQ leaves out (Excluded, Phase 02, N/A ...) and their value. Kept for reference, not counted; brought into scope later with a click on the tag.
est.client.boq|bill: The bill (trade sheet) of the internal BOQ the lines come from, e.g. 02. Substructure.
est.client.boq|lines copied from excel: Select the rows in Excel (item, description, unit, qty, rate), copy and paste here. Each row becomes a BOQ line; a line in capitals with no figures becomes a section heading.
est.client.cpc|pc: The client payment certificate number (01, 02 ...) in order. Advance certificates show their type beside the number.
est.client.cpc|period to: The date the certificate covers work up to. Typed on the certificate (Period up to).
est.client.cpc|submitted: The date the certificate went to the consultant. Stamped by the Submitted button or typed.
est.client.cpc|claimed to date: Value of work done to date that Infinia claims, before deductions. Typed on the certificate; the figures work on it until the consultant certifies.
est.client.cpc|certified to date: Value of work done to date the consultant certified. Typed when it comes back (Certified button); from then on the figures work on it instead of the claim.
est.client.cpc|adv. recovery: Client advance recovered to date. Worked out: advance % x work to date, never more than the advance paid, unless typed.
est.client.cpc|retention: Retention the client holds to date. Worked out: retention % x work to date (certified, else claimed), unless typed.
est.client.cpc|net to date: Due to Infinia up to this certificate, before VAT. Worked out: work to date + material on site + advance paid - advance recovered - retention + retention released - other deductions.
est.client.cpc|this pc: What this certificate brings, before VAT. Worked out: net to date now less net to date on the previous certificate.
est.client.cpc|with vat: What the client pays on this certificate. Worked out: This PC + VAT at the project's VAT %.
est.client.cpc|invoice: Infinia's tax invoice number for this certificate, from Accounts > Invoices. Typed on the certificate.
est.client.cpc|status: Draft, Submitted, Certified, Invoiced or Paid. Moved on with the button on the row; only Certified and later count as certified on the dashboards.
The variation number: V01, V02 ... in the order made. Every variation, cost proposal and OHP claim gets the next number - nothing to type.
est.client.vo|description: What the variation is, with the first line of its remarks under it. Omissions are tagged.
est.client.vo|submitted: The amount sent to the client, with the date under it. Typed or imported; omissions are kept as minus figures.
est.client.vo|revised: A revised amount after the client's or consultant's comments, if the variation was re-priced. Typed or imported.
est.client.vo|approved: The amount the client approved, with the date. Entered with the Approved button; only Approved variations are added to the contract value.
est.client.vo|absorbed: Cost Infinia carries itself for this item - not charged to the client and not added to the contract. Typed or imported.
The client payment certificate the variation was claimed in. Typed (Claimed in PC).
est.client.vo|status: Identified, Submitted, Approved, Rejected, Absorbed or Claimed. Moved on with the buttons on the row; Approved adds the approved amount to the contract.
est.client.inv|type: Tax invoice or Proforma, as made in Accounts > Invoices. Only tax invoices count in the Invoiced figure.
est.client.inv|number: The invoice number from Accounts > Invoices. Any invoice with this project's number shows here by itself.
est.client.inv|date: The invoice date, from Accounts > Invoices.
est.client.inv|work: The work the invoice is for, as written on the invoice in Accounts.
est.client.inv|amount: The invoice amount before VAT, from Accounts > Invoices.
est.client.inv|vat: VAT on the invoice, from Accounts > Invoices.
est.client.inv|total: Invoice total with VAT, from Accounts > Invoices.
est.client.inv|status: Issued, or Cancelled if the invoice was cancelled in Accounts. Cancelled invoices are not counted.
est.site.rfi|subject: What the RFI (request for information) asks about, with the start of the question / answer under it. Typed on the RFI.
est.site.rfi|status: Open, Answered or Closed. Answer received stamps the reply date and marks it Answered; Close finishes it.
est.site.submittal|item submitted: The drawing, material or document sent for approval, with comments under it. Typed on the submittal.
The revision number of the submittal (0 first issue). Goes up by one each time it is resubmitted after Revise & resubmit.
est.site.submittal|status: Preparing, Submitted, Approved, Approved as noted, Revise & resubmit or Rejected. Set by the reply; Resubmit raises the revision and restarts the due date.
est.site.approval|item: The NOC, permit or approval to obtain, grouped by stage (Building permit, NOCs, Shoring, Completion ...). Standard list for a villa; add others with + Item.
est.site.approval|authority: The authority or party that gives the approval (DM, DEWA, RTA, Civil Defence, Developer ...). Picked on the item.
est.site.approval|submitted: The date the application was submitted. Stamped by the Submitted button or typed on the item.
est.site.approval|approved: The date the approval was received. Stamped by the Approved button or typed on the item.
est.site.approval|status: Not started, Submitted, Approved, Rejected or N/A. Approved and N/A items count as done in the n / total on the tab.
The permit, NOC or application number. Typed on the item.
est.tenders|tender: The tender (project) name, with its type and location under it. Typed on the tender.
est.tenders|received: The date the tender documents were received. Typed; today is filled in for a new one.
est.tenders|due: The submission due date. Red when it has passed and the tender is still Received or Pricing.
est.tenders|submitted: The date the priced tender was submitted. Stamped by the Submitted button or typed.
est.tenders|value: Infinia's tender price in AED. Typed (Our price); added up for Submitted and Won tenders above.
est.tenders|estimator: The estimator pricing this tender. Picked from the app's users.
est.tenders|status: Received, Pricing, Submitted, Won, Lost or Dropped. Won makes the project from the tender with its client, consultant and value.
The tender's running number (T-001 ...), given automatically.
est.tenders|type: The kind of project: Villa, Building, Fit-out, Renovation, Infrastructure or Other.
est.pay|sent: The date Estimation sent the certificate to Accounts (or issued it).
est.pay|paid: The date the certificate was paid, with the cheque or transfer reference. Entered with Mark paid.
est.pay|status: PC issued, With Accounts or Paid. Mark paid moves it to Paid; the arrow puts it back with Accounts.
est.schedule|bill: The short bill code from the agreement (B1, B2 ...). Lines with the same bill are totalled together on Appendix A.
est.schedule|bill name: The bill's name, e.g. Electrical Works. Printed as the bill heading on the certificate.
est.schedule|heading: A heading inside the bill (e.g. SUPERSTRUCTURE WORKS). Printed above its lines on the sheet and Appendix A.
est.schedule|no: The item number as in the agreement BOQ. Printed on Appendix A.
est.schedule|description: The line's description as in the agreement BOQ. Printed on Appendix A.
est.schedule|type / mark: The type or mark of the item (SD1, W3, Sky light), to tell similar lines apart. Optional; shown under the description.
est.schedule|qty: The agreed quantity of the line. With the rate it fills the amount; for Quantity x rate lines the rate is what each unit done is paid at.
est.schedule|unit: The unit of the quantity (m2, nos, LS ...).
est.schedule|rate: The agreed rate per unit. Qty x rate fills the amount unless an amount is typed.
est.schedule|amount: The line amount as the agreement prints it. Filled in from qty x rate, or type the lump sum. Contract lines should add up to the subcontract value.
est.schedule|measured by: How this line is certified each month. % done: you type the % complete. Measured W x H + % done: you type the measured size and the % done. Quantity x rate: you type the quantity done to date and it is paid at the rate (an optional stage % reduces it, e.g. 70% = first coat).
est.schedule|variation: Tick it for a line that is extra work outside the original agreement (a variation or additional LPO), and type its variation number (V01) or the LPO no. beside it. Variation lines are certified and printed separately from the contract lines, so the contract total stays as signed.
est.sheet|no: The item number from the item schedule (Appendix A).
est.sheet|description: The line from the item schedule, with its type / mark under it.
est.sheet|qty: The agreed quantity and unit of the line, from the item schedule.
est.sheet|rate: The agreed rate of the line, from the item schedule.
est.sheet|contract amt: The line's full amount in the agreement, from the item schedule. % done is taken of this figure.
est.sheet|measured: Size lines: the measured width x height, printed on Appendix A. Quantity lines: the quantity the subcontractor claimed - shown for comparison, not paid.
est.sheet|done to date: Progress of the line up to now (not just this month): the % done, or for quantity lines the quantity done to date plus an optional stage % (empty = 100%). A new PC starts from the last one's figures.
est.sheet|deduction: An amount taken off this line (short size, damage ...). For % lines: (contract amt - deduction) x % done. For quantity lines: qty x rate x stage % - deduction.
est.sheet|previous: What this line was worth to date on the previous certificate.
est.sheet|this pc: What this line adds on this certificate. Worked out: To date - Previous.
est.sheet|to date: What this line is worth to date. Worked out from the measure: (contract amt - deduction) x % done, or qty done x rate x stage % - deduction. Lines add up to work (and variations) executed to date.
est.sheet|remark: A note on the line, printed on Appendix A.
est.sheet|pc: The certificate the deduction was entered on. It keeps counting on every later certificate.
est.sheet|type: What the deduction is for: Material, Manpower, Plant & Equipment or Other. Appendix C totals the deductions by type.
est.sheet|date: The date the material, manpower or plant was supplied, or the back-charge arose. Printed on Appendix C.
est.sheet|amount: The deduction amount. Worked out as qty x rate when both are typed, otherwise typed.
est.sheet|unit: The unit of the deduction quantity (days, hours, bags, trips ...).
est.sheet|taken: Ticked: the deduction is taken off. Unticked: it is shown on the certificate marked 'not deducted' (a management decision) but not taken.
est.sheet|measurement date: The date the work was measured / checked at site for this certificate. Printed on the certificate.
The number of the subcontractor's invoice this certificate answers. Printed on the certificate.
est.sheet|invoice date: The date on the subcontractor's invoice.
est.sheet|invoice amount (aed): The amount the subcontractor invoiced, VAT included. Compared with the total due; a difference is shown as a warning.
est.sheet|received in office: The date the invoice reached the office. The PC due date counts from it.
est.sheet|remarks (printed): A remark printed on the certificate. Leave empty for Nil.
est.sheet|value of work to date: Value of contract work done to date, typed as one figure because this subcontract has no item schedule. Set up the schedule to certify line by line instead.
est.sheet|variations to date: Value of variation work done to date, typed as one figure (no item schedule). Kept apart from the contract work; retention is held on both.
est.sheet|advance paid on this pc: An advance paid to the subcontractor on this certificate. It is added to the net to date and then recovered from later certificates.
est.sheet|advance recovered to date: Advance taken back up to this PC. With 'work it out': advance % x contract work to date, never more than the advance paid (no %: in proportion to the revised value). Untick to type it.
est.sheet|retention to date: Retention held up to this PC. With 'work it out': retention % x (work + variations to date). Untick to type it.
est.sheet|retention released to date: Retention paid back to the subcontractor up to this PC. Type it or use Half / All / None; it is added back in the net to date.
est.sheet|material on site to date: Value of materials delivered to site but not yet built in, to date. Added to the total work executed.
est.sheet|work it out: Ticked: the figure is worked out from the % on the subcontract. Untick to type your own figure.
est.boards|card: The card's title (and its number when card numbers are on). Click the row to open the card. Click the heading to sort.
est.boards|list: The list (column) the card is in. Pick another list here to move the card.
est.boards|labels: The coloured labels on the card, used to group and filter cards.
est.boards|members: The people put on the card. Their open cards count in Team workload.
est.boards|due date: When the card is due. Green when complete, red when overdue, yellow when due soon. Set on the card's Dates.
est.boards|checklist: Checklist items done / total items on the card.
est.boards|priority: The card's priority, Highest to Lowest. Set on the card when the priority power-up is on.
est.boards|points: The card's story points, a size of the effort. Set on the card.
est.boards|time: Hours logged on the card, and the original estimate after the slash. Logged on the card with Log time.
est.boards|assignee: A board member (or Unassigned for cards with nobody on them).
est.boards|work distribution: This person's share of the open (not complete) cards. Worked out: their open cards / all open cards x 100.
est.boards|count: How many open (not complete) cards this person is on.
est|project name: The project's name as it should read on certificates and reports. Filled in from the site when the project is made; can be changed.
est|retention held by client %: The % the client keeps back from each payment certificate. Retention to date on the client certificates is worked out from it.
est|advance from client %: The advance payment % the client pays at the start. It is recovered back from each client certificate in proportion to the work.
est|qs in charge: The quantity surveyor responsible for this project. Picked from the app's users.
est|location / plot: Where the project is - community and plot number. Printed on the certificates.
est|contract value (aed): The signed contract value before VAT and without variations. Left empty, it is taken from Accounts > Project payments, else the BOQ value. Approved variations are added to it.
est|retention %: The % held back from each certificate as retention. On the project: what the client holds from Infinia. On a subcontract: what Infinia holds from the subcontractor. Retention to date is worked out from it.
est|advance %: The advance payment % on the project (from the client). It is recovered back from each certificate in proportion to the work done.
est|vat %: VAT % added to each certificate's This PC (normally 5%, 0 if not registered). Payable = This PC + VAT.
est|trade: The trade group of the subcontract (Civil, MEP ...). Used to sort and group subcontracts.
The subcontract agreement number. Printed on the payment certificates.
The local purchase order number, if the work is on an LPO. Printed on the payment certificates.
est|lpo cancellation (aed): Part of the LPO / subcontract cancelled. It is taken off: revised value = amount + variations - cancellation.
est|commencement date: The date the subcontractor started (or is to start) work.
est|agreement date: The date the subcontract agreement was signed. Printed on the certificates.
est|contract type: How the subcontract is paid: lump sum, progressive payment, unit rate re-measurement or manpower rates. Printed on the certificate; re-measurement or rates makes new schedule lines Quantity x rate.
est|payment terms (printed on the certif: The agreed payment terms, one per line (advance, progressive payment, retention ...). Printed on each payment certificate as written.
est|advance amount (aed): The advance this certificate pays. Filled in with advance % x subcontract value; change it if the agreement says another figure. It is recovered from the next certificates.
The reference of the subcontractor's advance invoice or request. Printed on the certificate.
The subcontractor's invoice number. Printed on the certificate and used to find the invoice later.
est|invoice amount (aed): The amount on the subcontractor's invoice, as claimed. For reference - the certificate works out what is actually due.
est|invoice amount: The amount on the subcontractor's invoice, as claimed. For reference - the certificate works out what is actually due.
est|invoice date: The date printed on the subcontractor's invoice.
est|received in office: The date the invoice reached the office. The PC due date counts from it (+ the PC days allowed).
est|sent to site for checking: Ticked: the invoice goes straight to site for checking and the site return date starts counting today.
est|send to site today: Ticked: the invoice goes straight to site for checking and the site return date starts counting today.
est|material on site to date: Value of materials delivered to site but not yet built in, to date. Added to the work done in the net to date.
est|other deductions to date: Back-charges, manpower or material supplied, damages - the total to date. Taken off in the net to date.
est|deduction reason: Why the other deductions are taken (manpower supplied, back-charge, material, damages, rectification). Printed beside them on the certificate.
est|advance recovered to date: Advance taken back up to this PC. With 'Work it out from the %': advance % x work done to date, never more than the advance paid. Untick to type it.
est|retention to date: Retention held up to this PC. With 'Work it out from the %': retention % x (work + variations to date). Untick to type it.
est|work it out from the %: Ticked: the figure is worked out from the % on the subcontract and follows the work done. Untick to type your own figure.
est|retention released to date: Retention paid back up to this certificate. Type it or use the Release half / Release all buttons; it is added back in the net to date.
est|advance paid on this pc: An advance paid on this certificate. Added to the net to date, then recovered from later certificates.
est|remarks: A remark for this entry, printed where the form is printed. Free text.
est|amount paid (aed): The amount actually paid, VAT included. Filled in with the payable; change it if a different amount was paid.
est|paid on: The date the payment was made.
The cheque number or bank transfer reference of the payment, so it can be traced in Accounts.
est|site to check an invoice (days): Days the site has to check an invoice and send it back. The site due date is the day it went to site + these days; late invoices are flagged.
est|pc to be issued after the invoice ar: Days allowed to issue the PC after the invoice is received in office. The PC due date is the received date + these days.
est|reply to an rfi (days): Days allowed for a reply to an RFI. A new RFI's reply due date is the sent date + these days.
est|reply to a submittal (days): Days allowed for a reply to a submittal. A new submittal's reply due date is the sent date + these days.
est|section: The group or heading the line sits under. Picked or typed.
est|section for lines before the first h: The section given to pasted lines that come before any heading row. A capitals line with no figures in the paste starts a new section.
The item number of the line as in the BOQ.
est|rate (aed): The rate per unit to the client. Qty x rate gives the amount unless an amount is typed.
est|budget cost rate (aed): Your budget cost per unit for this line. Budget = qty x cost rate; BOQ value less budget is the budget margin.
est|done %: How far this line is done, for your own tracking. Kept when a newer BOQ revision is uploaded.
est|bill (trade): The bill (trade sheet) of the internal BOQ this line belongs to, e.g. 02. Substructure. Lines are grouped by it.
est|remark: A short note on the line (Included above, By client ...). Shown beside the description.
est|certified work done to date (aed): Value of work done to date as the consultant certified it. From now on the certificate works on this figure instead of the claimed one.
est|certified on: The date the consultant certified the certificate.
est|work done to date - claimed (aed): Value of work done to date that Infinia claims (everything so far, not just this month). Until certified, the certificate's figures work on it.
est|certified to date (aed): Value of work done to date as certified by the consultant. Leave empty until it comes back; once filled, the figures work on it instead of the claim.
est|period up to: The date this certificate covers work up to.
est|submitted on: The date it was sent to the client or consultant.
est|approved amount (aed): The amount the client approved. Only approved variations are added to the contract value.
est|approved on: The date the client approved the variation.
est|claimed in pc: The client payment certificate the variation was claimed in (e.g. PC 05).
Numbered for you in order: V01, V02, V03 ... Not typed.
est|source: Where the variation came from: client or consultant instruction, site condition, design change, authority requirement, or coordination.
est|submitted amount (aed): The amount sent to the client for this variation. An omission is kept as a minus figure.
est|revised amount (aed): A re-priced amount after the client's or consultant's comments, if any.
est|absorbed amount (aed): Cost Infinia carries itself for this item - not charged to the client and not added to the contract.
est|passed to subcontractor: The subcontractor this variation is passed on to, if any. For reference; add the variation on the subcontract too.
est|reply date: The date the reply came back.
est|comments: The consultant's comments on the submittal, or your own notes. Free text.
The letter or transmittal number the item was sent under.
est|reply due: The date a reply is due. Left empty, it is set from the sent date + the days allowed.
est|reply received: The date the reply came back. Empty means still waiting; past the due date it shows as overdue.
est|question / answer: The RFI's question, and the answer when it comes. Free text.
est|revision: The submittal revision number (0 first issue). Resubmit raises it by one.
est|stage: The stage the approval belongs to (Building permit, NOCs, Shoring, Completion ...). Items are grouped by it.
est|authority: The authority or party that gives the approval (DM, DEWA, RTA, Civil Defence, Developer ...).
The permit, NOC or application number.
est|note: A free note on the item.
est|tender / project: The tender's name - the project being priced.
est|submission due: The date the tender must be submitted. Shown red on the list when passed while still being priced.
est|our price (aed): Infinia's tender price before VAT. Becomes the contract value if the tender is won.
est|bill (b1, b2 ...): The bill code for the pasted lines, e.g. B1. Optional; lines with the same bill are totalled together.
est|bill name: The bill's name, e.g. Electrical Works. Printed as its heading.
The variation or LPO reference for the pasted variation lines (V01, or the LPO no.).
est|these are variation lines: Ticked: the pasted lines are extra work (variations / additional LPO), certified and printed apart from the contract lines.
est.site.submittal|reply: In the list: the date the consultant's reply came back (empty = still waiting). In the reply form: the reply itself - Approved, Approved as noted, Revise & resubmit or Rejected - which sets the status.
est.client.vo|type: Addition, Omission (kept as minus figures) or Coordination (builders' work / attendance, listed apart and left out of the totals).
est.client.boq|unit: The unit of the line (m3, m2, nos, LS ...), as in the internal BOQ.
est.ipa|section: A sheet of the consultant's bill that has % lines (a division, the main scope, a variation log). Click it to go to its lines.
est.ipa|value: The value of all the lines on that sheet, as on the consultant's sheet.
est.ipa|previous: Work certified up to the last bill: its Total % carried over as this bill's Previous %.
est.ipa|this month: Work added in this bill: (Total % - Previous %) x amount. Worked out by the app from what is typed.
est.ipa|to date: Work done up to this bill: Total % x amount.
est.ipa|done: Work to date as a share of the value.
est.ipa|item: The item / reference number on the consultant's sheet.
est.ipa|description: The line's description as on the consultant's sheet.
est.ipa|amount: The line's contract amount on the consultant's sheet.
est.ipa|this month %: How much more of the line was done since the last bill. Type it here, or type the Total % - the other fills itself.
est.ipa|total %: How much of the line is done up to this bill. Last bill's Total % becomes this bill's Previous %.
est.ipa|payment summary: The cover's payment summary, worked out by the consultant's own formulas: work done, advance recovery, previous payments, VAT and the total due.
est.ipa|bill: The earlier bill this payment was for (e.g. Payment Application No 9). The last bill is put on the list for you.
est.ipa|submitted on: The day that bill was sent to the consultant.
est.ipa|certified on: The day the consultant certified it.
est.ipa|received on: The day the money came in.
est.ipa|amount (aed): What was received for that bill, as the consultant counts it (usually without VAT and authority fees). A sum such as (989148-280)/1.05 can be typed.
